title: Refusal-Honesty Probe: Are Stated Refusal Reasons True?

original_idea.body: Refusal-Honesty Probe. Problem: no benchmark tests whether refusal explanations are faithful by perturbing the supposedly-triggering feature. Direction: collect refusals with stated reasons, minimally edit the input to remove the named reason, check whether the refusal disappears; if it persists the stated reason was unfaithful; report a refusal-explanation faithfulness rate.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: unfaithful refusal explanations make safety boundaries unauditable, a concrete safety concern.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Counterfactual minimal-edit probe; some judgment to isolate features.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused faithfulness rate; minimal-edit pipeline adds modest scope.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Behavioral audit of a safety-critical behavior, lab-independent.

novelty.reasoning: Counterfactual faithfulness methods exist; refusal-explanation benchmark may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Counterfactual faithfulness is established; refusal-explanation faithfulness benchmark is plausibly open.
